scope: Current noncanonical semantic/model-theoretic campaign and predecessor finite fixtures
authorized_statement: The current evidence is insufficient to claim that the calculus is complete, sound for all models, consistent, or model-independent.
reasons: only two finite relational models were tested
only a minimal conjunction rule set was tested
semantic truth was model-dependent for most compared predicates
general grammar and semantic interpretation remain incomplete
partial and undefined operator semantics remain bounded
no completeness or consistency proof was produced
not_statement: This boundary is not a proof that no complete calculus can be constructed.
